transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize the screening and deliberation protocol for the competition documentary, I'd like to run through the standard package-signoff routine. We need a round-robin check with distributor relations, accessibility, projection, and legal before I publish the final protocol. As a reminder, the jury screening is set for the 2:00 PM block on Saturday, with deliberations to follow immediately in the same cinema. Could each of you confirm your area is clear so we can proceed?

transcript.text: I need to flag a restriction from the distributor license I reviewed this morning. The countersigned license confirms that the film may be shown to the closed festival jury only from an encrypted DCP played offline. I haven't entered this restriction in the festival package yet because the signed license is still being indexed, but projection and legal need to be aware of this before we clear the protocol.
